{{Quote|Carib Diss owes me a favor. I helped him collect a pretty bounty last week. His ship can take three passengers.|Vicii|audio=Vicii-Diss.flac|<ref name="TROSEE">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]''</ref>}}
'''Carib Diss''' was a fearsome [[bounty hunter]]. The sensory organs of Diss' [[species]], the [[Skilla]], were situated behind an array of large [[Tooth|teeth]], meaning that in order to see, he had to grimace. His unsettling appearance intimidated most others, so Diss wore a [[sensor dome]] atop his head, helping him to gather data about his surroundings.

He owed the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi|Spice Runner]] [[Vicii]] a favor after receiving aid from him in the capturing of a [[bounty]]. In [[35 ABY]], he was present at the [[Spice Runners' Den]] in [[Kijimi City]] on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]], but repaid the favor he owed by getting Vicii and several other [[smuggler]]s offworld shortly before the planet was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Eternal]].

==Biography==
[[File:Carib_Diss_seated.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Carib Diss spent time in the Spice Runners' Den on Kijimi.]]
Carib Diss<ref name="TROS VD" /> was a [[Skilla]]<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> [[bounty hunter]] who was an inhabitant of [[Kijimi City]] on the [[planet]] [[Kijimi]] during its [[Occupation of Kijimi|occupation]] by the [[First Order]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> With aid from the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi|Spice Runner]] [[Vicii]],<ref name="TROSEE" /> he<ref name="TROS VD" /> collected a [[bounty]] during this period that Vicii considered pretty, leaving him owing a<ref name="TROSEE" /> great<ref name="Encyclopaedia">{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}}</ref> favor to the [[Spice]] [[Smuggler|Runner]]. The following [[Standard week|week]],<ref name="TROSEE" /> in [[35 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> Diss sat at a table by the bar of the [[Spice Runners' Den]],<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> which he frequented,<ref name="Encyclopaedia" /> with another [[alien]] and a [[human]] who was patting his back when a group of [[Resistance]] agents were led through the room by [[Zorii Bliss]], leader of the Spice Runners.<ref name="TROS" />

The presence of the Resistance agents on the planet led to a lockdown of Kijimi [[City]] by the First Order, which began rounding up the city's inhabitants for questioning. When the Spice Runners began planning to flee Kijimi to escape the First Order, Vicii informed the group about the favor that Diss owed him, stating that the bounty [[Hunting|hunter]] could carry three of them as passengers aboard his [[starship]].<ref name="TROSEE" /> Diss did repay the favor by allowing Vicii and several other smugglers to escape from Kijimi,<ref name="Encyclopaedia" /> shortly before the entire planet was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Eternal]]<ref name="TROSEE" /> after the First Order [[Protocol 13|evacuated]] its personnel.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Personality and traits==
Carib Diss was a terrifying bounty hunter and unsettling in appearance due to his [[species]]' odd arrangement of sensory organs. The [[Eye|photosensitive orbs]] he used to see, the [[Ear|vibrating cilia]] that he used to hear, and his [[Nose|smell receptors]] all lined a uvula-like bulb that hung from the roof of his large [[mouth]]. In order to see, he had to grimace and reveal his sharp [[Tooth|teeth]], which protected his vital organs<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> but intimidated most [[humanoid]]s<ref name="TROS VD" /> and created an objectively terrifying visage.<ref name="2024 Encyclopedia" /> Diss had [[Color|gray]] skin and was aware that he needed to clean his teeth more often.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Equipment==
In order to reduce the amount of [[time]] he needed to spend with his mouth agape,<ref name="TROSEE" /> so that he did not intimidate people unless necessary,<ref name="Encyclopaedia" /> Diss wore a custom-made [[sensor dome]] on top of his head as a [[Hat|cap]] that could gather data about his surroundings. He wore gray-and-orange [[armor]] over a brown [[jacket]], gray pants, and brown [[glove]]s and [[boot]]s. On his right [[Limb|arm]], he wore a [[Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian vambrace|rocket gauntlet]] loaded with [[whistling bird]]s.<ref name="TROS VD" /> Diss also owned a ship capable of carrying three passengers.<ref name="TROSEE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wizard_41.png|thumb|right|180px|"Wizard 41" concept art, which became Carib Diss]]
Carib Diss first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="TROS" /> and was first identified by name in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Concept art of Diss for the film, titled "Wizard 41," was created by creature concept designer and senior sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]].<ref name="Art">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''</ref> The names of Carib Diss and his species, the Skilla, are near homophones of [[Wikipedia:Charybdis|Charybdis]] and [[Wikipedia:Scylla|Scylla]], a pair of [[Wikipedia:Sea monster|sea monsters]] in [[Wikipedia:Greek mythology|Greek mythology]], the latter of who had multiple mouths of large teeth.<ref name="Britannica">{{WebCite|url=https://www.britannica.com/topic/Scylla-and-Charybdis|text=Scylla and Charybdis|author=The Editors of Encyclopædia Britannica|date=1998-07-20|work=[[Wikipedia:Encyclopædia Britannica|''Encyclopædia Britannica'']]|archivedate=20250516105041}}</ref>
